'''Richard Haman''' (also written '''Rich Haman''' and '''Richard Harmon''') was a Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 86 in the Coruscant region, from Hawthorne, NJ.<ref name="decsq-coruscant" /><ref name="smlist" />

He played from just after the Hoth release and became a Squadron Member in November 1998, one of the first two in New Jersey. By 2000 he had been running tournaments for over two years. He ran [[RamapoCon II]] with [[Scott Lingrell]] on 6 May 2000.<ref name="ramapo2000">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-reportd741/ RamapoCon II Day 2 Director's Report], Scott Lingrell, DeckTech (13 May 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026024315/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-reportd741/ Internet Archive].</ref> Outside the game he was a police officer.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
I am RED 86, one of only three squadron members from NJ and was one of the first two in NJ.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
